summary: Regression backend testing for Gabriel Section XIII (Pont Savard) update. Verified: (1) SYSTEM_PROMPT in gabriel_service.py includes new Section XIII block with psi_savard equation, 4 canonical validations (28.888, 96.894, 226.894, -100.798), Ensemble = 1/x + 1/t + 1/ms structure, and 3 concordances C1/C2/C3. (2) File methode_spectral.thy is 3180 lines. (3) section_XIII.py module (418 lines) is present. (4) /api/gabriel/compute nth_prime(33)=137 exact. (5) /api/gabriel/gap(5,47) returns gap_float=-41.0 exact. (6) Gabriel LLM correctly explains Section XIII/Pont Savard, enumerates C1/C2/C3, and knows psi_savard(30,10)=28.888 canonical value. 11/11 pytest passed in 36.4s.
critical_code_review_comments: SPECTRAL_SYSTEM_PROMPT now spans lines 12-~200 of gabriel_service.py and is very large. Consider extracting to a separate .md/.txt template file and loading at startup - improves readability and lets Section XIII updates happen without touching Python code.
server.py remains at 6799 lines - persistent recommendation to split /api/gabriel/* endpoints into their own APIRouter file (e.g., modules/gabriel/routes.py).

/api/gabriel/gap response is inconsistent: uses 'gap_count' (positive int) AND 'gap_float' (signed float). The signed value is what the review request expects ('ecart entre 5 et 47 = -41'). Consider aliasing 'gap' as the canonical signed value for API stability.
gabriel_conversations dict in server.py L6631 is an in-memory session store (not persisted, not thread-safe across workers). Fine for MVP, but note for future scale.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_gabriel_section_xiii.py is a stable regression suite covering: SYSTEM_PROMPT content assertions (fast, offline), .thy line-count guard (>=3000), deterministic spectral endpoints (nth_prime=137, gap 5<->47=-41), and 3 LLM behavioral checks (Section XIII explanation, three concordances, psi_savard(30,10)=28.888). Each LLM call ~7-10s, ~36s total suite. If the SYSTEM_PROMPT is refactored to load from an external file, update the import-based assertions to read the resolved template instead of the module constant.
